text: じゅんびは　ばんたん　いせき　たんけんに　いくぞ！

structure.jp: じゅんびは　ばんたん
いせき　たんけんに　いくぞ！
structure.en: I'm off to explore the ruins!

patterns.name: 〜に (purpose)
patterns.explanation: に before いく tells you what you are going for. たんけんに　いく = 'go exploring'.

patterns.name: 〜ぞ
patterns.explanation: ぞ at the end is a rough, manly way of adding force, often to fire yourself up. いくぞ = 'I'm going!'
